title: Standard Deviation: How Spread Out Is the Data

scenes.narration: Two classes have the same average mark. One class is consistent. The other is all over the place. How do we measure that spread?

props.title: Standard Deviation
props.subtitle: How spread out is the data?

scenes.narration: Here are eight values. Their mean is five. Each value sits at some distance from that mean. Look at how the bars are spread around it.
Standard deviation is the typical distance from the mean. For these values it is two. Most values lie within one sigma of the mean.
Variance is the average squared distance from the mean. Standard deviation is its square root. That brings the units back to normal numbers.
Quick recap. Mean gives the center. Standard deviation gives the spread. Your practice task: compute both for five numbers of your own.

props.title: Recap
items: Std dev is its square root
